vocabulary_concerns: TRUE_IS_SATISFIED means satisfaction of the proposed antecedent only. “Should not in the ordinary course” retains both modality and an ordinary-course qualification. FALSE does not establish business status or a licensing obligation.

“Not receiving any income, other than reimbursement of operating expenses from the family” is narrower than no net profit or no commercial fees. Other income cannot silently be excluded, and reimbursement cannot silently include a markup.

Profit capability, actual profit, income receipt and pursuit of profit as a business objective are distinct. The source lists capability and purpose separately; the Boolean profit_objective must not collapse them.

“Being run as a business” and “carrying on a business in Hong Kong” occupy different roles in the sentence and surrounding inquiry. The income abstraction cannot establish a general definition or determine territorial connection.
